resources.string: Share your photo, video, music and file library to any device connected to the same Wi-Fi network.
The server is running! From your other devices, open the following website:
When you\'re ready to log in, click on the button below to get the authentication code.
If you\'ve finished uploading all the files, click on the button below to stop the server.
The server is not running. Click on the button below to start the server. If you want, you can also change the port.
Unable to start the server: please grant full file access before trying again.
To log in on your other device, add the code you\'ll find in the next line. %1$s
Please grant storage access, since otherwise WebShare can\'t work.
Other devices connected to the same Wi-Fi network can see your files.
Calculate the folder\'s size. This will make the Files section of the website slower.
Android might require that you manually select your external drive so that it can be seen or modified by WebShare. Click on the button below to do that.
Here below you can find all the folders you\'ve manually enabled access to. Click on one of them to revoke access.
Do you want to update WebShare from version %1$s to version %2$s?
You can find the open source licenses list in the web app\'s settings.
Allow third-party clients to access to WebShare. This will enable CORS for this server.
